name: Hermes OAuth and MCP setup
description: Hermes agent on Mac Mini — OAuth token limits, CLI backend for Opus, MCP server, credential sync
type: reference
---

Hermes AI agent runs on Mac Mini (`ssh hexnashed@100.70.202.4`).

- **OAuth token** (`sk-ant-oat01-*`): Synced from `~/.claude/credentials.json` every 10 min
- **Cron script**: `~/.hermes/scripts/sync-oauth-token.py`
- **Critical**: OAuth tokens only allow **Haiku** for direct API calls. Sonnet/Opus get 400 errors.
- Sync script also updates `~/.claude/.credentials.json` (Claude CLI credentials)
- `~/.hermes/auth.json` must have `"active_provider": "anthropic"`

- **Telegram/Discord chat**: Uses `claude -p` CLI backend → gets **Opus** access
  - Config: `chat.backend: claude-cli`, `chat.model: claude-opus-4-6`
  - Code: `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/hermes_mcp/claude_cli_backend.py`
  - Loads prefill-messages.json for full brain vault context
  - Falls back to internal agent (Haiku) if CLI fails
- **Cron jobs**: Uses `claude -p` CLI backend → gets **Opus** access
  - Config: `cron.backend: claude-cli`, `cron.model: claude-opus-4-6`
  - Code: `~/.hermes/hermes

- **Location**: `~/.hermes/hermes-agent/hermes_mcp/hermes_mcp_server.py`
- **Tools**: terminal, send_message, read_file, write_file, search_files, memory_search, memory_keyword_search, web_search, web_extract, cron_list, cron_trigger, cron_pause, cron_resume, get_session_history, hermes_status
- **Mac Mini config**: `~/.claude.json` points to local venv python
- **MacBook Pro config**: `~/.claude.json` uses SSH transport
